description: This file defines the 'AudioInputDeviceObserver' class responsible for monitoring and managing audio input devices on macOS. It provides methods to get default input device info, list active input devices, start and stop listening for device changes, and handle device properties such as UID, name, and status.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: A final class that observes and manages audio input device changes on macOS, providing static methods for retrieving device info and instance methods to start and stop listening for device change events.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the default input device if available.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Retrieves UIDs of all alive input devices on the system.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks if the system has a default input device that is alive and has input channels.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string for the default input device, including name and UID.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceID
methods.description: Retrieves the AudioObjectID of the default input device.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for changes to audio devices and default input device, executing the provided callback on changes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for device change events.

methods.name: deviceUID
methods.description: Retrieves the UID string for a given device ID.

methods.name: deviceName
methods.description: Retrieves the human-readable name for a given device ID.

methods.name: deviceIsAlive
methods.description: Checks if a device with the given ID is alive.

methods.name: deviceHasInput
methods.description: Checks if a device with the given ID has input channels.
